Commentary.Commentary: That is it from us for this game. But do not go anywhere. Now you can join us for the next match between Kenya and Namibia.

Papua New Guinea skipper Assad Vala says it has been a brilliant performance from the boys. Adds they got a good score on the board and the bowlers did well to defend it. Finishes by saying they are happy with their performance.
Singapore captain Amjad Mahboob says credit goes to Papua New Guinea because they bowled and batted well. Adds they should have done better than this and would look to improve in future.
Man of the Match is Damien Ravu for his outstanding bowling performance of 4/18.

On the other hand, Singapore were very poor with the ball. Their batsmen also did not apply themselves and that caused their downfall. They lacked fight and intent also. Only Tim David was the top scorer for them with 44.

What a performance by Papua New Guinea. They have ALMOST qualified for the 2020 T20 World Cup. One more win should seal the deal. It has been an all-round performance from them. They have been clinical in all departments. Their batting was outstanding as Charles Amini and Kiplin Doriga's partnership proved to be crucial.

OUT! Run out! That is an exceptional piece of fielding from Charles Amini and it is a diamond duck for Chandramohan! Boy, are PNG pumped up? You bet. A length ball, around middle, Gaznavi tucks it towards mid-wicket and calls for a quick single. Amini comes charging in, dives and then in the same motion flicks it at the striker's end and hits the stumps! Now, unfortunately, for Surendran, while trying to put his bat in, it gets stuck outside the crease and falls down. Up goes the umpire's finger. What a start!
